 Highlight to Headline Singapore's Countdown Concert at The Kallang
 4 mins ago Highlight is the first performer announced to headline The Kallang Countdown 2027 concert. 
 The band formerly known as Beast, now consists of Lee Gi-kwang, Son Dong-woon, Yang Yo-seob, and Yoon Doo-joon. 
 The Kallang Countdown 2027 will take place at Stadium Roar on 31 December 2026. 
 Highlight joins an international lineup of stars performing at The Kallang Countdown 2027 this New Year’s Eve.
 Everyone loves a comeback story, and Highlight’s is one worth celebrating. Formerly known as Beast, the K-pop boy band will take the stage at The Kallang Countdown 2027, giving fans another reason to ring in the New Year in Singapore.
 As one of the leading groups in South Korean entertainment in the late 2000s, Beast debuted with members Jang Hyun-seung, Lee Gi-kwang, Son Dong-woon, Yang Yo-seob, Yong Jun-hyung, and Yoon Doo-joon, before their move from the music label Cube Entertainment to Around Us Entertainment in 2016. Following the departure of Jang and Yong, the band’s remaining members reprised their roles as Highlight in 2017 and went on to grow their list of critical accolades in music as a new outfit. 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Kallang (@thekallang.sg) 
 As a quartet, Highlight made their official appearances in Singapore in 2018, during an exclusive fan-meet event at Changi Airport, and in 2024, for a one-night-only concert date during their Lights Go On, Again Asia Tour at Singapore Expo. 
 Since their reintroduction, Highlight has produced five extended plays and four studio albums, including the full-length feature release, Daydream , in 2022, which marked their return to the stage following a three-year hiatus resulting from the pandemic and the military enlistment terms of its four members. 
 Taking place at Stadium Roar, Highlight will be part of an international lineup of entertainers taking over Singapore on New Year’s Eve, with more information on the full cast to be shared in phases later this November. On their participation, Highlight said, “To headline one of Singapore’s most iconic countdown events is an honour, and we promise to bring incredible energy to the stage. We can’t wait to celebrate with our fans as we ring in 2027 together.”
 Where: The Kallang Countdown 2027, Stadium Roar, Kallang, Singapore  
 When: Thursday, 31 December 2026 
 Contact: thekallang.com.sg
